name: Kronos
description: Kronos: A Foundation Model for the Language of Financial Markets
one_liner: An AI model trained specifically to understand and predict patterns in financial market data, the way language models understand text.
buyer: A quantitative trading shop or fintech startup that wants a ready-made foundation model for market prediction instead of training one from scratch.
business_use_cases: A small prop-trading team uses it as a base model to build and backtest new trading signals faster than training their own model from zero.
A fintech startup builds a retail-facing 'market trend' feature into a trading app, powered by the model's predictions.
A financial-research firm offers a paid report service that uses the model to flag unusual pattern shifts across a watchlist of assets.

money_ideas.idea: A paid API that returns the model's market-pattern predictions for a given ticker, billed per query.
A subscription research product that surfaces the model's flagged anomalies across a curated asset watchlist.

steal_this: Fine-tune it on one specific, narrow market (e.g. a single crypto pair) and ship a simple paid alert bot — do not pitch this as investment advice, pitch it as a research signal.
